notes: Chat threads stop asking whether to start a thread, what to do next, or whether a reading is right: the chat preamble (threads.ts) asks only for information it cannot get itself, starts the named thread type on go-ahead without confirmation, asks which type only when none is named, and drops the batch-every-decision nudge for chats. Zen mode no longer hides the answer before a question: a question (answered or not) or a pending approval ends the work, so the prose leading into it renders full size with the card under it (transcriptActivity.ts, AgentTranscript.tsx).
